title: Native FA3 anti-slop quality filtering without external runtime dependency
decision: Implement anti-slop-derived quality methodology as FA3-native deterministic policy, reusable task-scoped quality skills and delivery gates; do not install or depend on upstream anti-slop runtime or installer.
rationale: The method is useful as a filter but must not become a design authority.
FA3 already has Agent Native, Skill Fabric, Decision Fabric, GUI gates, UAF and supply-chain boundaries that should remain authoritative.
A native implementation avoids external runtime, installer and agent-entry-file mutation dependencies while preserving the useful quality concepts.
